supported_fields.unlock_method: Training with Gohan & Videl; current instructor guides list Hawk Charge as Lesson 2 Basic Reward
supported_fields.mechanics: Forward rush with elbow strike followed by palm follow-up; additional input can trigger the palm during the rush. Current skill documentation describes 2-hit Videl behavior and a 5-hit Gohan (DBS Super Hero) variant requiring 200 Ki.

limits: Variant-specific 200-Ki behavior is documented for Gohan (DBS Super Hero) and is not flattened into the base 100-Ki value.
No universal damage percentage is promoted as canonical.
Historical patch-note claims are retained as provenance and are not used to infer current hidden mechanics.
